title: EC2 개인 키 Jenkins Credential로 등록
markdown: ### EC2 개인 키 Jenkins Credential로 등록 --- ‣ - Jenkins → Manage Jenkins → Credentials ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8052-9f2f-d5c5361c6da9/c70948806e67af7b.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8052-9f2f-d5c5361c6da9/e5348012cb7e10da.webp) - Domains, (global) - Add Credentials ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8052-9f2f-d5c5361c6da9/a2c262483b852d8e.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8052-9f2f-d5c5361c6da9/2adfd32e9cb4ec64.webp) - credentials 값 입력 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8052-9f2f-d5c5361c6da9/8e2f5004e267bc51.webp) - kind: SSH Username with private key - scope: Global - ID: 실제 사용 시, 식별하는 키 - Description: credentials 에 대한 설명 ( 선택 ) - Username: OS에서 사용하는 유저명 사용 - Private Key: SSH 개인키의 value 값 입력 ```bash cat jenkins_prac.pem | pbcopy ``` - 그냥 복사 시, 공백 때문에 문제가 생길 수 있음 - Passphrase: credentials에 비밀번호 ( 선택 ) - CI/CD 구축에 사용 시, 일반적으로 설정 안함
excerpt: EC2 개인 키 Jenkins Credential 로 등록 --- ‣ - Jenkins → Manage Jenkins → Credentials - Domains, (global) &45; Add Credentials - credentials 값 입력 - kind&58; SSH Username with private key
